checks.value: * Certain information required by Items 5, 10, 11, 13 and 14 is incorporated herein by reference to the registrant

triage.note: WAS ENUMERATED DEBT (2026-08-17 to 2026-08-23), NOW A SCORED CASE. Boeing FY2003 marks Items 5, 10, 11, 13 and 14 as incorporated by reference with a bare typographic asterisk on the heading line, and states the reference ONCE, in a footnote sitting inside item 14's body: '* Certain information required by Items 5, 10, 11, 13 and 14 is incorporated herein by reference to the registrant's definitive proxy statement, which will be filed with the Commission within 120 days after the close of the fiscal year.' Items 11 and 13 therefore have EMPTY bodies — 34 and 59 chars, the heading line and nothing else. classify() reads one item's body at a time, finds no pointer phrase in an empty body, and returned `extracted` under ADR-005 rule 1 (trivial body). The result was the silent-failure shape this repo exists to hunt: 'Executive Compensation: extracted, confidence 0.95' over nothing at all, with no warning fired, because a 34-char span is neither missing nor obviously wrong to any label-free validator. WHY IT WAS NOT FIXED UNTIL D4: resolving a footnote that names OTHER items requires cross-item reference resolution, a capability the pipeline did not have and that the T8 freeze forbade adding (`docs/product/milestones.md`; tasks/TODO.md freeze guard). It was tagged 'debt' on the gs-2002 precedent: the runner executed it every run and printed its state, but excluded it from the score, so the gap stayed visible without either breaking the gate or being rewritten to assert the bug as correct. FIXED by D4 / ADR-031 (2026-08-23), a sanctioned post-freeze exception on the ADR-026/029/030 pattern: a heading whose line ends in an asterisk run, over an EMPTY body, is resolved by a footnote anywhere in the document that begins with the same marker run, names this item's code and carries both pointer signals (IBR_RE + EXTERNAL_DOC_RE) => `incorporated_by_reference` at BASE_IBR 0.85. Under ADR-011 the item's own span stays its heading line (the marker is the in-span evidence; pointing the span at the footnote would overlap item 14, which INV-S1 forbids) and the footnote's offsets are published at evidence.footnote, which the `text_contains` checks with an `evidence` key anchor here. Items 5 and 10 carry the same marker over real content and stay `extracted` 0.95 (ADR-004 shape 3: the footnote says 'certain information'); item 14 holds the footnote in its own body and is IBR by classify() as before — all three pinned so the rule cannot widen to a substantive body. `method` stays heading_strict: it names the heading-match tier (ADR-027 §b), and the heading was found strictly. MUTATIONS (2026-08-23): resolution call removed from extract.py -> RED (item 11 not incorporated_by_reference: extracted; item 13 likewise; confidence 0.95 != 0.85; 'item 11 has no evidence span footnote'); EXTERNAL_DOC_RE requirement in footnote_pointer swapped for INTERNAL_REF_RE -> RED (same lines: the proxy-statement footnote is not an internal pointer); footnote evidence key dropped -> RED on the two evidence anchors only.
